snippet.title: What If GTA Happened in Space? 🚀 5 Stars Wanted
snippet.description:
You just borrowed a rocket. Five stars. 🚀⭐ The police float there going nowhere, you can't hide a giant spaceship, the radio is pure static, and the nearest gas station is on Mars… then comes the twist.

Would you rather steal a rocket or the entire space station? Tell me below 👇

An imagined scenario, just for fun. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games.

FUN FACTS (open sources)
• Objects in orbit around Earth travel at about 28,000 km/h (NASA)
• A trip from Earth to Mars takes about 7 months (NASA)
• Sound can't travel through the vacuum of space (NASA)

Whatifaholic answers science, money, tech & AI "what ifs" in under a minute.
